scoring.count: Count each AST command node once, including SI, REPETE and their nested children, ignoring execution multiplicity
scoring.referenceOptimalityCaution: Reference scores are validated but not mathematically proven global minimum written program.

progression.unlockRule: Complete current simulation with any star rating to unlock next

controlRules.REPETE: Infinite; stop immediately on reaching flag, explicit failure, user stop, or safety watchdog
controlRules.SI: Executes body only when condition true; reevaluates each time execution visits the SI
controlRules.movementAndObjectRules: Follow V14.1 interactionRules, including keys/locks, plates/doors, portal orientation, crate-portal exclusion.
